name: Manganese
summary: Manganese carries an editorial Grade B rating, but the studies recorded on this profile do not demonstrate that grade. Recorded activity centres on oxidative stress modulation, metabolic regulation and vascular function support, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. excess exposure may cause neurotoxicity/manganism; risk higher with chronic high exposure.
description: Manganese is cataloged as essential trace mineral. Reported mechanisms: MnSOD cofactor; amino acid, cholesterol, carbohydrate metabolism support.
safetyNotes: excess exposure may cause neurotoxicity/manganism; risk higher with chronic high exposure
